Class PetriNetNode

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.nodes.Node
      • threepl.nodes.PetriNetNode
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TDEConstants, Constant

    public final class PetriNetNode
extends Node
implements Constant, TDEConstants
    This implements a petrinet statement. A petrinet statement is a target module.

        Add a transition to the Petri net.
        Parameters:
        from - is an identifier list of 'from' places
        to - is an identifier list of 'to' places
        strict - is true if the transition is strict rather than weak
        e - is a transition predicate (may be null)
        b - is a block of statements to be executed on the transition (may be null)

      • execute

        public Constant.EXECR execute(TDEVar esig,
                              java.util.ArrayList<TDEVar> startl,
                              java.util.ArrayList<TDEVar> finishl,
                              QueueRefs queues,
                              boolean toplevel,
                              boolean availok,
                              QueueRefs checkedqueues,
                              TDEVar pri_in,
                              TDEVar pri_out)
        Execute a petri net. This generates target code.
        Overrides:
        execute in class Node
        Parameters:
        esig - is an exception/restart signal, or null
        startl - is a list of start signals for target statements below this node
        finishl - is a list of finish signals for target statements below this node
        queues - returns all the queue availability signals accumulated from code below
        toplevel - is true if this is the top level in a module
        availok - is true if a previous sync makes a queue availability wait unnecessary
        checkedqueues - gives queue reads which have already been checked
        pri_in - is an optional input signal to a priority encoder
        pri_out - is an optional output signal from a priority encoder
        Returns:
        EXECR.NONE execution status value
